modules.module_name: End-to-End Stochastic Launch -> Flight -> Fuze -> Terminal Pipeline
modules.description: Full bias + random Monte Carlo pipeline propagating propellant lot/temperature variations, MPM/3-DoF aerodynamic flight, fuze reliability, Kingery-Bulmash blast & Mott/Gurney/THOR fragmentation, Carleton vulnerability, and OAT sensitivity.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Modified Point Mass assumes slowly varying yaw of repose and axisymmetric projectiles; L0 analytical mode uses linearized range approximations.

modules.module_name: Interactive 3D Trajectory Bundles, Blast/Frag Plumes & Phase Space
modules.description: 3D ground-clamped dispersion ribbons, Mach-colored time-animated flight traces, hemispherical blast shock shells, 3D Mott fragment trajectories, and 3D CAD projectile geometry.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Terrain surface option uses analytic Gaussian ridge unless coupled with a DEM grid.

modules.module_name: McCoy (1974) MCDRAG Aeroprediction & Parametric CAD Mesh
modules.description: Zero-yaw drag coefficient Cd0(M) built up from ogive nose wave drag, conical boattail base drag, rotating-band increment, meplat bluntness, and turbulent/laminar skin friction.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Valid for axisymmetric spin-stabilized projectiles across Mach 0.5-3.5 without canards or destabilizing fins.

modules.module_name: Module 1: Closed-Loop FCS, 3-State Kalman Tracker & Evasive Drones
modules.description: Couples EO/IR and Ku-band micro-Doppler measurement noise, turret servo rate/acceleration limits, processing latency, Singer-style 3-state (position, velocity, acceleration) Kalman filtering, and ballistic lead against evasive drones.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Assumes target acceleration correlation time consistent with agile quadcopters/FPVs and trapezoidal turret slew torque limits.

modules.module_name: Module 2: Multi-Drone Swarm Saturation & Sub-Salvo Doctrine
modules.description: Time-stepped engagement of multi-drone waves accounting for shoot-look-shoot, fixed full-array salvos, smart sub-salvo magazine allocation, inter-target azimuth slew, and defense boundary leakers.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Single-turret geometry baseline; see Module 12 for full multi-turret cooperative raid battlespace.

modules.module_name: Module 3: Advanced Payloads (TSS #2, Duplex, Flechette & Airburst)
modules.description: Compares high-density tungsten super-shot (18.2 g/cm3), duplex buck+bird loads, low-drag finned flechettes, and programmable airburst canister sub-fragment sprays against armored/light UAS components.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Assumes idealized velocity retention per sphere/flechette class without sabot-petal collision post-muzzle.

modules.module_name: Module 4: Recoil Impulse, 2-Axis Gimbal Torque & Pareto Optimizer
modules.description: Computes ejecta+gas recoil impulse, staggered balanced-pair firing offsets, gimbal bearing pitch/yaw peak moments, and constrained Pareto array selection across Pk, Peak Torque, and Shell Cost.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Assumes rigid gimbal cradle with first-order propellant gas momentum multiplier (k_gas ~ 1.5).

modules.module_name: Module 5: Elevated Pellet Fallout Ballistics & Friendly SDZ
modules.description: Integrates upward-fired shotshell pellets through climb, apex, and gravity descent under Bailey-Hiatt sphere drag and wind drift to determine maximum fallout range, terminal KE (2 J / 15 J thresholds), and Surface Danger Zones.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Advisory engineering model; operational firing safety templates must follow competent national authority (DA PAM 385-63 / UNODA).

modules.module_name: Module 6: Multi-Sensor Acquisition & Kill-Chain Timeline Budget
modules.description: Models weather-attenuated acquisition ranges for Ku-band radar, EO/IR thermal, acoustic arrays, and RF direction-finders (zeroing RF links against fiber-optic threats) through confirm, C2 handoff, slew, TOF, and shoot-look-shoot windows.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Sensor SNR detection scales as fourth-root of drone aspect RCS with log-normal weather attenuation bounds.

modules.module_name: Module 7: Multi-Turret Site Defense, DEM LOS Masking, NFZ & GIS Map
modules.description: Evaluates 360-deg coverage overlaps, 3D building prism & DEM terrain ridge LOS blind spots, friendly No-Fire Zone SDZ conflicts, terrain-adjusted fallout ranges, OSM map overlays, and RFC 7946 GeoJSON / KML exports.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: DEM interpolation uses bilinear sampling over regular Easting/Northing grids; tangent-plane WGS84 projection assumes local site radius < 10 km.

modules.module_name: Module 8: 3D Animated Single-Engagement Intercept Replay
modules.description: Time-synchronized 3D animation showing turret slew tracking, outgoing shot-string pellet cloud expansion, evasive drone kinematics, hit/miss frames, and ground fallout cones.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Single-drone engagement replay; for simultaneous multi-drone cooperative raids use Module 12.

modules.module_name: Module 9: Sustained Logistics, Barrel Thermal Cook-Off, $/Kill & Briefings
modules.description: Simulates multi-wave raids with magazine reload downtime, Newton barrel heating/cooling toward cook-off limits, cost-per-kill economics, SQLite Scenario Library persistence, and HTML/PDF/PPTX executive briefing exports.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Barrel heat transfer uses lumped thermal capacitance with exponential convective cooling between waves.

modules.module_name: Module 10: A/B Turret Architecture Comparator & Layered Soft/Hard-Kill Defense
modules.description: Benchmarks Candidate A vs Candidate B turrets across 6 normalized axes (Kill Rate, Stand-off Range, Stealth Resilience, Recoil Margin, $/Kill Efficiency, Logistics Endurance) and simulates outer EW/FPV/autocannon/HEL + inner shotgun waves.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Assumes statistical independence between outer EW/kinetic kill stages and inner shotgun intercept bursts.

modules.module_name: Module 11: Automated OAT Sensitivity & Bottleneck Tornado
modules.description: One-at-a-Time (OAT) +/- delta sweeps across 8 C-UAS kill-chain drivers and 7 fast vectorized exterior-ballistic CEP50 error-budget drivers to rank engineering bottlenecks.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: OAT ranking captures local main effects around the nominal operating point and does not include second-order cross interactions.

modules.module_name: Module 12: Unified Dynamic 3D Cooperative Multi-Turret Tactical Raid
modules.description: Combines Module 6 sensors, Module 2 swarm waves (including fiber-optic RF-immune drones & evasive weaves), Module 7 multi-turret geometry with 3D building/DEM LOS masking and NFZs, cooperative WTA handoff, barrel heating, and 3D animated raid replay.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Time-stepped dt=0.2s Monte Carlo engine prioritizes shortest time-to-impact unobstructed threats for idle turrets.

modules.module_name: Module 13: Field-Test Calibration & Empirical vs Model Residuals
modules.description: Fits Rayleigh choke spread factors from CSV patterning-board pellet coordinates, chronograph MV lot SD and FM 6-40 dMV/dT temperature slope, and exterior drag form factors (i) via SciPy nonlinear least squares with residual diagnostics.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Requires representative uncorrupted field CSV measurements; drag form-factor fit holds environmental conditions fixed.

modules.module_name: Small Arms Mode 1: Shotshell Pattern Spread & Longitudinal Shot Stringing
modules.description: Rayleigh radial pellet distribution conditioned on 40-yd 30-in choke efficiency, shot stringing velocity spread, Bailey-Hiatt sphere deceleration, and polygonal silhouette/drone hit checks.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Radial choke dispersion scales nonlinearly with distance exponent 1.15 due to wake aerodynamic separation.

modules.module_name: Small Arms Mode 2: Multi-Distance Range Sweep & 3D Plume Slices
modules.description: Evaluates 30-inch circle density, pattern R90, striking velocity, and single-pellet energy attenuation across distance stations.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Assumes sea-level/configured ambient density without cross-range terrain slope variation.

modules.module_name: Small Arms Mode 3: Barrel Length vs Muzzle Velocity & Dispersion
modules.description: Models interior expansion work variation across 14 in to 30 in shotgun barrels and downstream choke-cone velocity/time-of-flight impact.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Uses empirical shotshell barrel-length velocity delta slope calibrated to progressive smokeless powders.

modules.module_name: Small Arms Mode 4: SxS / O/U / Rotary Minigun Volley Dispersion & Thermal Walk
modules.description: Simulates fixed crossover regulation, rotary centrifugal tangent velocity, per-barrel bore run-out bias, thermal drift per 100 rounds, and drone aspect lethality.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Thermal barrel walk is modeled linearly per 100-round burst without transient asymmetric cooling.

modules.module_name: Small Arms Mode 5: Anti-Drone Multi-Shotgun Defense Array
modules.description: High-resolution N-barrel (2-12) array volley simulation with circular/grid/staggered/concentric racks, balanced-pair firing symmetry, and 3D yaw/pitch/roll drone aspect vulnerability.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Pellet-to-drone kills accumulate critical hits weighted by exposed hull/rotor/battery/ESC component projected area.

modules.module_name: Physics Lab 1: STANAG 4367 Interior Ballistics & P-V Indicator Diagram
modules.description: Integrates Vieille burn law, grain form function, Noble-Abel covolume EOS, Resal energy balance, and Lagrange base/breech pressure gradient.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Lumped-parameter uniform-gas model without 1D two-phase ignition wave transients.

modules.module_name: Physics Lab 2: US Standard Atmosphere 1976, Miller Twist & Coriolis
modules.description: Evaluates 1976 ISA temperature, pressure, density, speed of sound, Miller gyroscopic stability Sg, and azimuth-dependent Coriolis deflection.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Miller rule calibrated to conventional copper-jacketed / tangent-ogive rifle projectiles.

modules.module_name: Physics Lab 3: Rankine-Hugoniot Shock Physics & Kingery-Bulmash Airblast
modules.description: Full 7-parameter Kingery-Bulmash polynomials, Kinney-Graham free-air pressure, dynamic & reflected pressure, Sachs altitude scaling, and Friedlander waveform.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: KB fits apply to unconstrained hemispherical surface or spherical free-air charges in Z = 0.05-40 m/kg^(1/3).

modules.module_name: Physics Lab 4: Gurney Energy, Taylor Detonation Angles & Mott Fragmentation
modules.description: Initial fragment velocity for cylindrical/spherical/sandwich charges, Taylor projection angle deflection, and Mott exponential/mass-number fragment spectra.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Assumes natural casing fragmentation with steady detonation wave and negligible premature gas venting.

modules.module_name: Physics Lab 5: Lanz-Odermatt Long-Rod, Birkhoff Jet, De Marre & THOR
modules.description: Evaluates Project THOR perforation equations, Lanz-Odermatt WHA/DU/steel long-rod penetration, De Marre naval armor empirical limits, Forrestal-Frew concrete penetration, Modified NDRC scabbing/perforation, and Recht-Ipson / Lambert-Jonas residual velocity.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: TF-12 and TP-01 carry FLAG governance status and require empirical verification outside standard caliber/material bands.

modules.module_name: Physics Lab 6: Quasi-Monte Carlo Sobol vs LHS Convergence & KB Explorer
modules.description: Demonstrates 1/N vs 1/sqrt(N) Quasi-MC convergence across 16 supported probability distributions, salience order statistics, and salvo binomial scaling.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Scrambled Sobol sequences require power-of-2 sample counts for strict digital net balance.

modules.module_name: Physics Lab 7: STANAG 4355 MPM Yaw of Repose, Spin Decay & Magnus Drift
modules.description: Models quasi-equilibrium yaw of repose vector, aerodynamic spin-damping decay, yaw-drag quadratic growth, and gyroscopic spin drift.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Valid for statically/dynamically stable projectiles whose epicyclic yaw damps within a few calibres of muzzle.

modules.module_name: Physics Lab 8: Bayesian Fuze Reliability, Clopper-Pearson UCB & Graze Surface
modules.description: Beta-Binomial posterior dud-rate updating, zero-failure upper confidence bounds (FZ-04), armed/low-order/dud state trees, and oblique impact graze S-curves.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Point-detonating vs proximity modes use user-supplied Beta priors calibrated to lot acceptance tests.

modules.module_name: Physics Lab 9: Precision Guidance & Proportional Navigation (TPN / APN)
modules.description: Closed-loop interceptor engagement simulation with True PN, Augmented PN, first-order autopilot lag, G-limiter saturation, and zero-effort miss distance.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Uses planar/3D kinematic engagement closure with constant or maneuvering target acceleration.

modules.module_name: Physics Lab 10: Cluster Munition Dispenser Kinematics & UXO Contamination
modules.description: Models air-burst dispenser spin/ejection velocities, submunition ground elliptical footprint, and persistent UXO contamination under humanitarian dud thresholds.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Modeled solely for humanitarian UXO remediation and submunition hazard-footprint engineering assessment.

modules.module_name: Physics Lab 11: Full 6-DoF Rigid-Body Ballistics & Epicyclic Pitch/Yaw
modules.description: Integrates 13-state rigid-body quaternion translational and angular equations resolving nutation, precession, Magnus moments, and damping.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Requires linear aerodynamic moment derivatives (CM_alpha, CM_q, CM_p_alpha) representative of axisymmetric shells.

modules.module_name: Physics Lab 12: Artillery Battery Sheafs & MRSI / Time-on-Target Salvos
modules.description: Computes Converged, Parallel, Linear, and Circular battery aim-points plus high/low-angle charge schedules for simultaneous MRSI impact.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Assumes surveyed battery gun offsets and synchronized digital fire-direction countdowns.

modules.module_name: Physics Lab 13: Multi-Layer Armor, Ceramics & Explosive Reactive Armor (ERA)
modules.description: Models tandem precursor + main warhead interactions against composite ceramic/RHA/spaced stacks and moving ERA flyer plates.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: One-dimensional hydrodynamic/continuum stack approximation; edge/corner perforation effects excluded.

modules.module_name: Physics Lab 14: Counter-Battery Radar POO & POI Back-Integration
modules.description: Reconstructs Point of Origin (POO) and predicts Point of Impact (POI) using noisy radar ascending-arc observations and backward/forward trajectory fitting.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Assumes known or estimated ballistic coefficient across observed Doppler tracking arc.

modules.module_name: Physics Lab 15: Direct-Fire Tank Gunnery, APFSDS Sabot & Moving Lead
modules.description: Evaluates flat-trajectory supersonic APFSDS velocity drop, cant/crosswind drift, moving-target lead, and RHA perforation margin.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Assumes sabots discard symmetrically cleanly inside first 50 m downrange.

modules.module_name: Physics Lab 16: Electronic Warfare GNSS Jamming & Laser Homing
modules.description: Computes Friis free-space J/S jamming ratio along projectile trajectory to detect GNSS burn-through/denial plus Beer-Lambert SAL laser spot range.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Assumes line-of-sight jammer propagation without terrain multipath cancellation.

modules.module_name: IATG Tool 1: Quantity-Distance (QD), Open Detonation & 3D PES Map
modules.description: Computes Inhabited Building, Public Traffic Route, and Process Building Quantity-Distance rings plus open-detonation debris hazard distances.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Subject to USE_LIMITATION_NOTICE; final facility licensing requires competent-authority UNODA / national QD board approval.

modules.module_name: IATG Tool 2: Structural Brick-House Damage & Swiss Glazing Hyperbola
modules.description: Evaluates Scilly/Jarrett masonry categories (A-E) and Swiss Pressure-Impulse glazing failure curves across NEQ and standoff distance.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Applies to unreinforced brick dwellings and standard annealed window panes under open blast waves.

modules.module_name: IATG Tool 3: NATO AASTP-1 Stack Fragmentation & Reinforced Concrete Debris
modules.description: Models hazardous fragment density (<1 per 56 m2 threshold), maximum fragment throw range, and NATO RC structural debris envelopes.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Fragment drag uses natural-fragment piecewise Mach bands unless spherical drag is selected.

modules.module_name: IATG Tool 4: Axelsson Thoracic Biomechanics ODE & Thermal Dose
modules.description: Integrates the Axelsson-Yelverton 1-DOF chest-wall response to incident/reflected blast waves and computes primary blast ASII, TNO probit [FLAG], and fireball thermal dose.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: TB-12 is FLAGGED (cannot be sole safety basis); Axelsson ASII assumes free-standing human torso oriented side-on/normal per test correlation.

modules.module_name: IATG Tool 5: Multi-Facility 3D ESA Site Planner & Sympathetic Matrix
modules.description: Audits pairwise Potential Explosion Sites (PES) and Exposed Sites (ES) in an Explosive Storage Area for sympathetic detonation and IBD/PTRD violations.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Ignores protective traversing/earth-covered igloo directional shielding factors unless explicitly input.

modules.module_name: IATG Tool 6: Propellant Aging & In-Service Surveillance (AOP-48 / IATG 07.10)
modules.description: Predicts DPA/EC stabilizer depletion curves under Arrhenius diurnal climatic storage zones (A1/A2/B2/C1/ECM), Semenov thermal runaway cook-off, and ISO 2859-1 lot inspection plans.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Arrhenius pre-exponential factors calibrated to representative single- and double-base propellants; lot surveillance requires heat-flow calorimetry / HPLC verification.

modules.module_name: IATG Tool 7: Terrain Crest Clearance, Dead Space & KML/CZML Export
modules.description: Verifies FM 6-40 >=50 m ridge crest safety buffer, identifies shadowed artillery dead space behind terrain crests, and exports KML/CZML geospatial tracks.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Terrain profile uses configurable ridge geometry or uploaded/external DEM elevations.

modules.module_name: Tabular Firing Tables (TFT) & STANAG 4082 METCM Wind Shear
modules.description: Generates non-standard ballistic firing tables incorporating Table E propellant temperature MV deltas, STANAG 4082 upper-air density/temperature zones, and Ekman spiral wind shear.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: All built-in projectile presets are strictly NOTIONAL; live gunnery must use certified national firing tables.

modules.module_name: Knowledge Base Verification & Regression Suite (V-01a .. V-12)
modules.description: Audits 22 analytical and stochastic test vectors (V-01a through V-12) against UNODA IATG, Kingery-Bulmash reference values, THOR tables, Lanz-Odermatt bounds, Axelsson ODE, and LHS convergence.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Verifies solver mathematical fidelity to published standards; does not substitute for live range certification.

modules.module_name: Compressible & Rarefied Sphere Drag + Sutherland Viscosity
modules.description: Continuous Reynolds-Mach-Knudsen spherical pellet and fragment drag (Morrison 2013, Loth 2008, Henderson 1976, Bailey-Hiatt 1972) coupled with Sutherland air viscosity and analytical quadratic-drag TOF.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Smooth non-rotating spherical particles in continuum to transition slip-flow regimes; irregular fragments apply shape factors.

modules.module_name: Concrete Penetration (Forrestal-Frew) & Modified NDRC Perforation
modules.description: Ogive-nose kinetic projectile concrete depth of penetration via Forrestal-Frew empirical S-factor equation alongside Modified NDRC scabbing and perforation slab thickness limits.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Unreinforced to lightly reinforced concrete; perforation thresholds assume rigid non-deforming nose shapes within calibrated caliber-radius-head range.

modules.module_name: Extended 18-Benchmark Physics V&V Suite & Audit Certificates
modules.description: Independent analytical and empirical verification suite (B-01..B-18) covering ISA-1976 50 km atmosphere, compressible sphere drag, vacuum flight, 6-DoF/MPM spin stability, concrete penetration, Tate-Alekseevskii, Mach stem blast, TNO probits, Craig elliptical CEP, Saltelli Sobol indices, and ISO 2859-1 sampling with HTML/Markdown certificates.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Self-contained numerical regression tolerances verify implementation fidelity against closed-form reference physics and standards.

modules.module_name: C-UAS Scientific V&V, Digital Twin Calibration & High-Fidelity Terminal Physics
modules.description: ASME V&V 20 blind holdout validation, Ferson-Oberkampf area validation metric, Latin Hypercube epistemic x aleatory P-boxes, Recht-Ipson oblique V50(theta) ricochet, 3D STL CAD mesh ray-casting, native range-instrument parsers, 4-fiducial photo homography, and live Wald SPRT with Clopper-Pearson intervals.
modules.assumptions_and_limits: Single-stage pellet ballistic limits assume isotropic spherical or flechette impactor geometry with calibrated cosine obliquity scaling.

data_tables.description: 80 curated primary standards, NATO STANAGs/AOPs, UNODA IATG guidelines, US Army field manuals, peer-reviewed papers, and textbooks with verification flags.
96 formal ballistics, vulnerability, reliability, blast, fragmentation, penetration, and Monte Carlo equations with governance flags (TB-12, TF-12, TP-01).
G1 (79 Mach pts), G7 (84 Mach pts), and Natural Fragment (12 piecewise Mach bands) reference drag curves.
TNT pressure/impulse equivalence (16 HE), IATG & S05 Gurney velocities/densities (9-15 HE), Mott fragmentation B constants (11 HE), and UFC heats of detonation (12 HE).
Piecewise log10(Z) polynomial coefficients for Ps, Is, Pr, Ir, U, ta, and td including bombcad positive-duration middle-branch sign verification.
Empirical fragment perforation exponents and residual velocity coefficients across 17 target materials plus 3 fragment shape factors.
Lanz-Odermatt coefficients (WHA, DU, steel; semi-infinite & perforation) and De Marre naval armor empirical constants.
QD scaled factors, Scilly brick-house categories, Swiss P-I glass limits, Axelsson ASII injury thresholds, and thermal dose criteria.
Physical air constants (R, gamma, g0, rho0) and 53 altitude stations from 0 to 50 km.
30 munition classification codes (AR, CN, SA, MO, RK, MS) mapping applicable physical sub-models and fidelity levels.
22 closed-form and stochastic acceptance reference vectors (V-01a through V-12) paired with 18 extended physics verification benchmarks (B-01 through B-18).
Shotgun/TSS/Flechette loads, SAAMI/choke 30-in @ 40-yd benchmarks, micro-Doppler/EO-IR/acoustic sensors, UAV CAD/RCS silhouettes, and outer EW/FPV/HEL interceptors.
